question.prompt: When counting from \(3\) to \(201,\) \(53\) is the \(51\)st number counted. When counting backwards from \(201\) to \(3,\) \(53\) is the \(n\)th number counted. What is \(n?\)

solutions.explanation:
Counting backward from \(201\), we take \(201-53=148\) steps to reach \(53\). Since \(201\) itself is the first number counted, the position is one greater than the number of steps. Thus
\[
n=148+1=149,
\]
which is choice D.
solutions.title: Count the backward steps
